name: Haptics
description: Build hardware systems that bring touch, force, scent, and movement into XR experiences, including wearable gloves, force-feedback arms, olfactory displays, and omnidirectional treadmills.

name: BCI
description: Explore brain-computer interfaces as alternative input methods for VR, including a more generalizable BCI controller.

name: Software
description: Develop software experiences and companion systems for XR, including smart-glasses applications that use persistent memory and computer vision to help users recall where objects were seen.

name: Game
description: Create VR games in Unity, including experimental stealth-horror experiences that test novel mechanics.

name: Business
description: Coordinate CUXR's logistics and business operations.
